headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: AIADMK Attacks CM Vijay in By-Polls Campaign, Targets Family Ties and State Leadership Claims.
Sharad Pawar puts a stop to merger speculation, says he won’t join anyone.
bullets_ur: AIADMK ne by-polls campaign mein CM Vijay par hamla kiya, family ties aur state leadership claims ko nishana banaya.
Sharad Pawar ne merger ki qiyaas-araiyon ko rok diya, kaha woh kisi ke saath shamil nahi honge.
'Kalaburagi ko regional second capital ke taur par develop kiya jaye'.
